author: ghyls
body:
#### PR description:

This PR includes the following three small changes, independent from each other but all affecting `MPICore`.

- Fix the `HeterogeneousCore/MPICore/testMPISoATransfer` test, by adding
```python
process.load("Configuration.StandardSequences.Accelerators_cff")
``` 
to the follower side, so that, if e.g. cuda is selected by the controller the follower selects it as well.

- Add `HeterogeneousCore/MPICore/TUNING.md`, documenting some MPI runtime tuning parameters that we find relevant.

- Minor changes to the MPI portable modules:
  - Make the configuration interface more consistent between the portable and non-portable MPI modules. For cleanliness, but also to simplify the job of a future version of the `edmMpiSplitConfig` that will generate configs for these modules.
  - `MPISenderPortable.cc`: Check that a path is active before reading any product, also as done in the `MPISender.cc`.
  - Other very minor correctness changes.

#### PR validation:

The test that was failing (`HeterogeneousCore/MPICore/testMPISoATransfer`) now passes.
No new tests have been added.
title: Minor improvements to `HeterogeneousCore/MPICore`
